name: dgraph-live
description: dgraph-live — Dgraph graph database live loader. Bulk import RDF/JSON data into Dgraph clusters.

install_steps: curl -LO https://github.com/dgraph-io/dgraph/releases/latest/download/dgraph-linux-amd64.tar.gz && tar xzf dgraph-linux-amd64.tar.gz && sudo mv dgraph-live /usr/local/bin/ && rm -rf dgraph*
install_guidance.note: Binary from GitHub or official packages.
